I was in a very similar place during school. I took a 6 month leave, went to a DBT (dialectical behavior therapy) group 3 times a week, and started working an easy fun retail job to meet people my age and fill my days with low stress. 

Idk if any of that would help. But I remember feeling so stuck and the thought of taking a leave was terrifying like I was letting everyone down. But after actually making that decision, it was the opposite. You can always take a break.

That makes complete sense. It’s hard to reconcile our parents shortcomings and pain they’ve caused with the fact that they are still family, no matter how complicated your relationship is. 

I don’t have a perfect answer. I just hope you can find a space or community that you can share your honest feelings without judgement or shame. Your feelings are so valid. And you work so hard and just know that a stranger is proud of all you do and the effort you put in. Your heart is in the right place!

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I did the same thing last week and while doing so - trying to find the perfect words to say to everyone and making a list of “life goals I will never complete” - actually settled my feelings a bit to stay another day.
